title: CLI contract X17a: evolve loop status with an extra word starts a real loop; it must go to the status reader and exit 10
summary: isLoopStatusInvocation takes the read-only path only when status is alone or the next word starts with - (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_status.go:14-16). evolve loop status foo goes to the loop parser, parsePositional joins the words into the goal 'status foo' (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_args.go:307-323), and the reserved-word guard refuses only an exact reserved word (:178-181). So a read with one wrong word starts a batch. Spec: docs/architecture/cli-contract.md §8; ADR-0156 rule 16.
fix: Route each call whose first positional word is status to the status reader, also after leading flags such as --project-root P. The status reader refuses each extra word with exit 10. --goal-text status still launches by design.
acceptance: RED first: TestLoopStatus_AnExtraWordNeverStartsALoop runs evolve loop status foo with a fake loop runner and records a launch before the change; after the change it exits 10 and records no launch
evolve loop --project-root P status prints the report (today it exits 10 from the reserved-word guard)
evolve loop --goal-text status still starts a loop
Changed functions at 100% coverage; cli-contract.md §8 and the loop status bullet of runtime-reference.md updated
